1	// Room "P0 dining room" (interior designer's part). Box x10..12, z14..17, floor layer y1, feet at y2.
     2	// The focal piece is a long table along x11 (z14..16): oak fence posts with top slabs, three stair chairs on the
     3	// window side (x12), a barrel sideboard with a potted poppy in the north-west corner (x10, z14). One hanging lantern
     4	// and two candles sit over the table. Lanes stay clear: x10 z15..17 from the west opening, x11 z17 to the kitchen
     5	// door, and x12 z17 in front of the hearth mouth at (13,2,17).
     6	import { layers } from "/Volumes/ext1/swe/repos/minecraft-design/tools/src/build.mjs";
     7	
     8	export function build(g) {
     9	  // feet level y2: the sideboard, the table posts and the chairs
    10	  layers(g, [10, 2, 14], {
    11	    B: ["barrel", { facing: "up", open: "false" }],
    12	    T: "oak_fence",
    13	    C: ["oak_stairs", { facing: "east", half: "bottom" }],
    14	  }, ["BTC", ".TC", ".TC", "..."]);
    15	
    16	  // y3: the table top (top slabs on the posts) and the pot on the sideboard
    17	  layers(g, [10, 3, 14], {
    18	    P: "potted_poppy",
    19	    S: ["oak_slab", { type: "top" }],
    20	  }, ["PS.", ".S.", ".S.", "..."]);
    21	
    22	  // y4: candles on the table, a lantern hanging from the upper floor's ceiling over its middle
    23	  layers(g, [10, 4, 14], {
    24	    k: ["candle", { candles: "1", lit: "true" }],
    25	    L: ["lantern", { hanging: "true" }],
    26	  }, [".k.", ".L.", ".k.", "..."]);
    27	}

input.summary:
parts/room-3.mjs ("P0 dining room") now places nothing: the 14 furniture writes were REFUSED because shell-west fills the whole room interior with air, and runParts locks air. The design is kept as commented code with restore notes.
make.sh runs clean: the P0 dining room line shows "0 placed" with no REFUSED or OFF-PALETTE, and build.nbt is written (5948 cells).
The dining room is unfurnished; the fix belongs upstream in shell-west's air fill, which I did not touch.
left: The P0 dining room has no furniture. Its table, sideboard, chairs, candles and lantern are commented out in parts/room-3.mjs, because shell-west.mjs house() fills the interior (x3..12, z14..20, y2..top) with air and runParts locks every air cell an earlier part placed.

The same lock will refuse every furniture write in the other room parts (P0 hall through P7 south-east bedroom) once they write, since their boxes sit inside the same air fill. The fix is for the shell to leave interior cells unowned, or for runParts to allow room parts to write into air. That is a plan or shell change, not a room-3 change, and I did not edit other modules.

OFF-PALETTE was not reported for these blocks because refused writes never reach the palette check. I confirmed by hand that barrel, oak_fence, oak_stairs, oak_slab, potted_poppy, candle and lantern are all in palette.json roles, so restoring the design should not add off-palette blocks.

waste.what: Found out that the whole room box was locked by shell-west's air fill only by reading shell-west.mjs and runParts source, then worked out cell by cell which of the 14 writes fell in owned cells.
waste.cost: about 6 tool calls, reading two modules and the runParts source, plus one full rewrite of room-3.mjs
waste.tool: runParts REFUSED report should name the owning part and the cause (e.g. 'owned by shell west, house() air fill'), and a free-cells query such as `mcd plan --free <box>` should say before a designer writes that the box is wholly locked.

waste.what: Checked palette membership of the furniture blocks by reading palette.json roles by eye.
waste.cost: one extra grep-style read of palette.json
waste.tool: runParts counts off-palette blocks only after the lock check, so refused writes escape the palette report. Running the palette check before the lock check (or a `mcd blocks --check` pass over each part's blocks) would have reported OFF-PALETTE for room-3 at the same time as REFUSED.

companions.task: Decide how the shell leaves room interiors unowned (or whether runParts lets room parts write into air) so the P0 dining room furniture can go back in; this is a plan-level change to shell-west, not to this room.
Fit the oak fence table posts, top slabs, barrel sideboard and stair chairs once the interior is open to the room part.
Hang the chained-free lantern over the table and set the two candles, checking light levels with mcd light for the dining room.
